passRule: A request passes when no hard check fails. State and log-block checks sit at the product's own bars (choice confidence 0.75, block probability 0.5). The six risk-* requests ask a score question that this runner cannot check; they have no expect here and are scored by score-expectations.json with the product rule: approval is added when score >= 2.5 or confidence < 0.75.
